experimental_design: XIAP overexpression (IP-MS) and XIAP knockdown (iTRAQ) comparison

After ectopic overexpression of XIAP in UMUC3 cells and pull-down with anti-HA beads, IP-MS was used to detect proteins that interact with XIAP. Next, we identified proteins that were differentially expressed after knockdown of XIAP by iTRAQ.
